verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI documents explicit non-interactive/scripted execution (gemini-cli-gh-6) with structured JSON and streaming JSON output flags for programmatic consumption (gemini-cli-gh-17, gemini-cli-gh-18), plus GitHub Actions integration for PR reviews and issue triage showing real CI usage (gemini-cli-gh-10, gemini-cli-gh-11). Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of headless/CI reliability at scale (community evidence focuses mostly on interactive coding quality, not automation-mode robustness).
